RUN.about: Cut by the journey of a new user — they land on the marketing page, sign up, choose a subscription plan via Stripe, manage their team on the dashboard, and adjust account settings — with shared database infrastructure off the path.

issues.detail: AvatarImage receives an `alt` prop but no `src`, so the image element never loads and the fallback is always displayed. The user's profile picture can never appear in the header.

AUTHORED.title: Signing In
AUTHORED.sub: How a visitor creates an account or logs in, gets a session cookie, and is allowed into protected pages
AUTHORED.detail: A shared `Login` component handles both modes. Server actions validate with Zod, hash with bcrypt, issue a signed JWT cookie, and redirect to `/dashboard` or Stripe checkout.

group.note: Four concerns that together get a user from anonymous to authenticated: form, account creation, session tokens, and route protection.

issues.title: Plaintext password returned in action state
issues.detail: Both `signIn` and `signUp` return the user's plaintext password in the error response object. The `Login` component reads `state.password` as a `defaultValue`. The password travels from server action back to the client in the serialized React state.

issues.title: signOut crashes on expired session
issues.detail: `signOut` casts `getUser()` to `User` with no null check. If the session cookie is expired or missing, `getUser()` returns null, and accessing `.id` on the next line throws a runtime error.

issues.title: Double expiry check can diverge
issues.detail: The JWT has an `exp` claim set by `setExpirationTime`, AND the payload has an `expires` field checked by `getUser()`. The global middleware refreshes only the JWT while `getUser()` checks the payload's `expires` — they can disagree after a refresh.

issues.title: Middleware checks cookie presence, not validity
issues.detail: The protected-route guard at line 12 tests only `!sessionCookie`. An expired or tampered cookie passes the gate; the JWT is only verified inside the refresh block for GET requests. A POST with a garbage cookie is not caught here.

issues.title: Inconsistent auth failure behaviour
issues.detail: `validatedActionWithUser` throws an unhandled Error on missing user, while `withTeam` redirects to /sign-in. Callers see either an exception or a navigation depending on which wrapper the action uses.

issues.title: Displayed trial and actual trial differ
issues.detail: The pricing page reads `trial_period_days` from the Stripe price (7 days from seed), but `createCheckoutSession` hardcodes `trial_period_days: 14` on the session. The user sees "7 day free trial" but receives 14 days.

issues.title: No unique constraint on (userId, teamId) in team_members
issues.detail: The team_members table has no composite unique index. A bug in application code could insert the same user into the same team twice, and `getUserWithTeam` would silently pick an arbitrary row.

issues.title: Role columns are unconstrained varchars
issues.detail: Both `users.role` and `teamMembers.role` accept any string up to their length limit. The app assumes 'owner' or 'member' but the database does not enforce it.
